identity.name: Kyodo News
identity.description: Japan's leading nonprofit cooperative news agency, supplying domestic and international news, photos and video to Japanese and global media.

ownership.ownershipNotes: A nonprofit cooperative owned by Japanese newspapers and broadcasters. Its English service, Japan Wire, distributes Japan and Asia news internationally.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Cooperative ownership and wire-service standards; straight-news file is source-attributed and nonpartisan.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Kyodo News Least Biased with High factual reporting; the English wire is fact-focused.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage reports corporate and policy positions without a consistent ideological programme.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Japanese national and regional lens with strong coverage of Japan-US and Japan-Asia relations.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; cooperative wire with professional standards.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Least Biased; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Japanese wire-service coverage. It prioritises confirmed facts from Japan and Asia, with an institutional and regional perspective.

selectionRationale: Adds a Japanese cooperative wire perspective alongside Nikkei and The Japan Times, improving Asia-Pacific breadth.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirms cooperative structure and English wire mission. Feed validated. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
